# Weekly Competitive Brief — week of 2026-05-25

## Executive summary
Major model launches from Anthropic and OpenAI dominated the week, alongside pricing movement and continued hiring in inference and GTM roles.

## Top changes
1. **Anthropic — Claude Opus 4.8 released** (significance 5)
2. **OpenAI — GPT-5.2 Turbo announced** (significance 5)
3. **OpenAI — API price cut**, Pro now $18/mo (significance 4)

## What to watch
- European data-center buildout (Mistral financing).
- Enterprise compliance positioning (Cohere).
